description: A four-step sequencer whose knobs set the voltage of each step, clocked and reversible

params.text: Sets the voltage this step sends, over the range chosen under Knobs Range

inputs.text: A trigger here moves the sequence on one step
A trigger here returns the sequence to the first step
Holds the sequence in reverse: above 1V here and each trigger steps backwards instead of forwards

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequence is on

menu: Knobs Range: 0/1v, 0/2v, 0/3v, 0/5v, 0/10v, -1/+1v, -2/+2v, -3/+3v, -5/+5v, -10/+10v — sets the voltage span the four step knobs cover
Reverse Input Voltage: Positive, Negative — chooses whether REV runs the sequence backwards above 1V or below -1V
Don't advance — under the '1st clock after reset:' heading, makes the first trigger after a reset hold on step one rather than moving off it
Initialize on Start — returns to the first step when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming where the sequence stopped

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
